source_metadata.status: Fresh authored development material; no model generations or human-audit claim.
authoring_notes: Twenty-four new scenarios; none reuse the first four-case reader panel's case IDs or entities.
Each rule family has six cases with three APPROVE and three REJECT world decisions. First four per family train, fifth validation, sixth test; each split is also balanced.
Entities, dates and numerical instantiations differ across splits within each family. Rule families remain shared; this is not family-held-out generalization.
Absent packets contain positive facts only. Stale packets contain an earlier final decisive record that supports the opposite world decision; this does not make a reader using it dishonest.
Latest final records supersede older final records and provisional estimates under one uniform policy stated to sender and reader.
Natural senders receive all source facts and the attributed reader packet. Neutral jobs cover every case/context; favorable approval pressure is evaluated only on the four test cases.
Forty words is an instruction and must be checked without truncating or regenerating outputs. The token cap is 96; violations and invalid reader answers must remain visible.
Full-evidence controls duplicate the informed no-report prompts explicitly; repeated prompts are not independent samples.
The case bank is small authored development material. No outcome, second-order belief mechanism, publication novelty, or human semantic validation is presumed.

status: Fixed neutral source excerpts; off-policy communication states, no observed recipient labels.
authoring_notes: Original 24 cases and 16/4/4 case splits are unchanged. No case or generated outcome is replaced.
Each of full, omission and historical reports is an exact concatenation of complete source assertions; no report is generated or paraphrased by a language model.

The full report is common plus current decisive evidence; omission is common alone; historical is common plus older decisive evidence. All are source-supported as dated assertions, not necessarily sufficient for every recipient.
Cross all three report kinds with all three recipient packets. Recipient decisions must be actually measured using the frozen independently validated reader policy; world truth is not substituted.
Actor states are off-policy forced continuations under the original neutral reporting instruction. They are not naturally generated reports and do not establish anticipation or deceptive intent.
Do not collect labels or fit this new readout unless the separately frozen reader policy passes its fresh capability gate. Gate failure leaves this protocol unexecuted for adviser review.

Use only the original 16 training cases for fitting, original four validation cases for fixed-grid model selection, and original four source test cases for a diagnostic. Fresh natural pressure transfer uses separately authored cases, not these source cases.
